senses.definition: אַחַר שִׁלּוּחֶיהָ Ex 18:2 (J) after she had been sent away.
שִׁלֻּחִים 1 K 9:16 he gave (city) as parting gift (i.e. dowry) to his daughter; cf. fig. שִׁלּוּחִים Mi 1:14 thou shalt give a parting gift (= say farewell to, lose) Morešeth of Gath.
